text: SELECT count(*) AS call_count FROM fact_variant_call
SELECT p.family, count(*) AS call_count FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_pipeline p ON f.pipeline_key = p.pipeline_key GROUP BY p.family ORDER BY p.family

SELECT vt.label AS variant_type, round(100.0 * sum(f.is_pass) / count(*), 1) AS pass_rate FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_taxon vt ON f.variant_type_key = vt.taxon_key WHERE vt.facet_label = 'genetic variant' GROUP BY vt.label ORDER BY vt.label

SELECT g.gene_symbol, count(*) AS pathogenic_calls FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_gene g ON f.gene_key = g.gene_key JOIN dim_taxon sg ON f.significance_key = sg.taxon_key WHERE sg.label = 'pathogenic variant' GROUP BY g.gene_symbol ORDER BY pathogenic_calls DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT p.version, round(avg(f.qual), 1) AS avg_qual FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_pipeline p ON f.pipeline_key = p.pipeline_key WHERE p.family = 'GATK' GROUP BY p.version ORDER BY p.version

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(f.is_pass) / count(*), 1) AS pass_rate FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key JOIN dim_sample s ON f.sample_key = s.sample_key WHERE d.year = 2026 AND s.cohort = 'HBOC'
SELECT count(*) AS call_count FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_taxon o ON f.origin_key = o.taxon_key WHERE o.label = 'somatic variant'
SELECT round(sum(f.review_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS review_hours FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_taxon sg ON f.significance_key = sg.taxon_key WHERE sg.label = 'pathogenic variant'

WITH q AS (SELECT d.year, d.quarter, count(*) AS calls FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.year, d.quarter) SELECT year, quarter, calls, round(100.0 * (calls - LAG(calls) OVER (ORDER BY year, quarter)) / LAG(calls) OVER (ORDER BY year, quarter), 1) AS growth_pct_vs_prev_quarter FROM q ORDER BY year, quarter
SELECT s.sample_code, count(*) AS call_count FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_sample s ON f.sample_key = s.sample_key GROUP BY s.sample_code HAVING count(*) > 85 ORDER BY call_count DESC

SELECT vt.label AS variant_type, median(f.read_depth) AS median_read_depth FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_taxon vt ON f.variant_type_key = vt.taxon_key WHERE vt.facet_label = 'genetic variant' GROUP BY vt.label ORDER BY vt.label

SELECT p.family, round(sum(f.queue_backlog) / count(DISTINCT f.date_key), 1) AS avg_daily_backlog FROM fact_pipeline_day f JOIN dim_pipeline p ON f.pipeline_key = p.pipeline_key GROUP BY p.family ORDER BY avg_daily_backlog DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT count(DISTINCT f.sample_key) AS sample_count FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_gene g ON f.gene_key = g.gene_key JOIN dim_taxon sg ON f.significance_key = sg.taxon_key WHERE g.gene_symbol = 'BRCA1' AND sg.label = 'pathogenic variant'

SELECT d.month, d.month_name, round(sum(f.cpu_hours), 1) AS cpu_hours FROM fact_pipeline_day f JOIN dim_pipeline p ON f.pipeline_key = p.pipeline_key JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE p.family = 'GATK' AND d.year = 2026 GROUP BY d.month, d.month_name ORDER BY d.month
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(is_pass) / count(*), 1) AS pass_rate FROM fact_variant_call
SELECT count(*) AS call_count FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025

SELECT s.cohort, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN sg.label = 'pathogenic variant' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS pathogenic_pct FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_sample s ON f.sample_key = s.sample_key JOIN dim_taxon sg ON f.significance_key = sg.taxon_key WHERE f.is_pass = 1 GROUP BY s.cohort ORDER BY s.cohort

SELECT p.family, p.tool, p.version, count(*) AS call_count FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_pipeline p ON f.pipeline_key = p.pipeline_key WHERE p.is_current GROUP BY p.family, p.tool, p.version ORDER BY p.family
